text.autoconfig.tenthslot.title: Tenth Slot
text.autoconfig.tenthslot.option.showOnl: Show Only When Hotbar Is Full
When enabled, the tenth slot is only shown when all 9 hotbar slots are occupied.
text.autoconfig.tenthslot.option.vanilla: When disabled, offhand item actions are blocked while the tenth slot is selected (using items, placing blocks, eating, drinking, etc.).
When disabled, non-item right-click interactions are blocked while the tenth slot is selected (opening doors, mounting, trading, opening block GUIs, etc.).
When disabled, left-click interactions are blocked while the tenth slot is selected (attacking entities, breaking blocks).
